The '''Raquish system''' was a part of the [[Lambda sector/Legends|Lambda sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It shared its name with the [[Battle of Raquish]], which was fought in [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and pitted the [[Spiverelda/Legends|Spiverelda]], the group of [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] [[Colonist/Legends|colonized]] by the [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and being under the influence of<ref name="EGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> the Aqualish [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]], [[Ando/Legends|Ando]],<ref name="CSWE Ando">{{CSWECite|I|30|Ando}}</ref> against<ref name="EGTW" /> the fifteen Aqualish-settled planets known as the [[Andoan Free Colonies/Legends|Andoan Free Colonies]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|30|Andosha II}}</ref> The Raquish [[Star system/Legends|system]] was also the namesake of the [[Treaty of Raquish]], which regulated the use of military forces by the Andoan Free Colonies in the aftermath of<ref name="Insider67">{{InsiderCite|67|CIS Shadowfeed Dispatch 14:4:12 Edition}}</ref> the Battle of Raquish, and the [[Raquish Thoroughfare]] roadway in Ando's [[Quantill City]].<ref name="HNN">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Raquish system was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-15.<ref name="TEA" />
